author: Mushfiq Sajib
text:
Google’s AI note-taking app just got a major upgrade with Gemini.

And it's 100% free to use.

Here’s how to take advantage of Google’s NotebookLM: ⤵️

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Get access:

→ Go to 
https://
notebooklm.google

→ Click ‘Try NotebookLM’

→ Sign up with your Gmail account

→ If you're outside the U.S, just use a VPN or Opera Browser

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Collaborate with a virtual research assistant:

When you upload the documents that are central to your projects, NotebookLM instantly becomes an expert in the information that matters most to you.

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Go from information to insight:

NotebookLM gives you a powerful new interface that lets you shift effortlessly from reading to asking questions to writing, with an AI thought partner helping you at every turn.

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Get to your first draft faster:

When you've curated a set of notes based on your sources, you can use NotebookLM to transform them into an outline, blog post, business plan, and more.

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Add your docs:

Click "New source" and select the Docs you want to add to your Notebook (as many as you want).

NotebookLM will automatically give you a summary or "Source Guide" for the Docs you upload.

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Ask questions:

In your Source Guide box, you'll also see auto-generated questions to try — it’s the ultimate ChatPDF.

You can also opt to ask your own questions.

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Pin quotes:

NotebookLM automatically shares citations from your sources whenever it answers a question.

So you can quickly jump from a citation to the source, letting you see the quote in its original context.

topReplies.author: Mushfiq Sajib
topReplies.text:
Change formats:

NotebookLM also helps organize your notes into structured documents.

Simply select a set of notes you’ve collected and ask NotebookLM to create something new, like a study guide or email newsletter.
